correctness.rationale: Every independence-set flip graph embeds isometrically into a Boolean cube: delete A\B, then insert B\A gives distance |A triangle B|, so shortest paths change each coordinate at most once and any Θ_i∪Θ_j is edge general position. For any exterior edge e in coordinate k, if ij is nonadjacent construct a shortest path deleting e and old set then restoring i,j as applicable; if ij adjacent with no common neighbor, split neighbors into disjoint classes and construct a monotone geodesic across e plus both Θ classes. If ij lies in a triangle with common neighbor k, e=empty–{k} cannot share a shortest path with both Θ_i and Θ_j since endpoints would require the adjacent i,j simultaneously; then e can be added. Therefore maximal exactly outside triangle edges, giving binom(n,2)-t_triangle(H). Independent exhaustive direct shortest-path checks of all 74 labelled graphs on n=2..4 (410 coordinate-pair tests) agreed, using a separate shortest-path edge-distance inclusion method.
